name: field_equations
title: Field equations from the action (general fields of t, r)
description: Raw (unsimplified) output of the derivation: Einstein, Klein-Gordon, fluid and baryon equations (each = 0) for the metric diag(e^{2Phi}, -e^{2lambda}, -r^2, -r^2 sin^2 theta) and fields Phi, lambda, a, n, xi of (t, r). Some terms are very long; the readable forms are the static limit (background.pdf) and the linearizations of D1/D2.

Gtt.label: G_tt - 8 pi G T_tt
Gtt.text: -8*pi*G*(((-m_N + mstar(a(t, r)))*n(t, r) + n(t, r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n(t, r)), n(t, r)))*exp(4*Phi(t, r))/(exp(2*Phi(t, r)) - exp(2*lambda(t, r))*Derivative(xi(t, r), t)**2) - (-epsilon0(n(t, r)) + n(t, r)*Derivative(epsilon0(n(t, r)), n(t, r)))*exp(2*Phi(t, r)) - (-V(a(t, r)) - exp(-2*lambda(t, r))*Derivative(a(t, r), r)**2/2 + exp(-2*Phi(t, r))*Derivative(a(t, r), t)**2/2)*exp(2*Phi(t, r)) + Derivative(a(t, r), t)**2) + (2*r*Derivative(lambda(t, r), r) + exp(2*lambda(t, r)) - 1)*exp(2*Phi(t, r) - 2*lambda(t, r))/r**2
